presets.name: Single close mic
presets.desc: One miked cab at zero latency, onset trimmed and level-matched to a typical cab IR
presets.notes: The default: whatever IR golem picks plays at the library's usual level, so swaps do not jump

presets.name: Two-mic blend
presets.desc: A dynamic and a ribbon of one cab blended, aligned by correlation so the pair cannot comb
presets.notes: Set ir_b to the second mic of the same cab; Correlation fixes polarity and the sub-millisecond lag

presets.name: Session-true blend
presets.desc: Two mics captured together kept at their recorded distance, the phase nudged by ear
presets.notes: Raw keeps the captured phase; move delay_b by ±0.1 ms to taste

presets.name: Mic sweep pedal
presets.desc: Expression sweeps from one mic position to another of the same speaker
presets.notes: EXP on blend 0 → 100 %: a two-point mic move; ir_b = the same speaker off-axis

presets.name: Tight metal rhythm
presets.desc: Proximity boom and fizz cut after the cab for palm-muted high gain

presets.name: Wide double cab
presets.desc: Two different cabs, one per side, from one amp
presets.notes: 2 / 2 only; ir_a and ir_b = two different cabs; with ir_b none it plays linked

presets.name: Bass cab over DI
presets.desc: The lows stay on the DI and the cab only colours the mids and highs
presets.notes: A bass cab IR in ir_a; below 120 Hz the dry plays instead of the cab

presets.name: Bass cab plus parallel DI
presets.desc: A bass cab with the clean DI blended under it

presets.name: Acoustic body
presets.desc: A piezo pickup through a body IR, the piezo kept underneath
presets.notes: A body IR in ir_a; normalize Off if the capture is unity-gain

presets.name: Small speaker
presets.desc: A phone or practice-amp speaker: thin, boxy, band-limited

presets.name: Room cab
presets.desc: A far-miked cab with its room, the whole IR kept
presets.notes: No forced truncation: a long room IR plays whole

presets.name: Tight minimum phase
presets.desc: IRs from different vendors blended in minimum phase: tight, no pre-delay, no combing

presets.name: Short IR
presets.desc: A cab trimmed to 40 ms with a fade, for a small board

presets.name: Dark lead
presets.desc: High cut on the expression pedal for a lead that darkens on the toe

presets.name: Raw parity
presets.desc: The file played exactly as it is, no trim and no level match
presets.notes: For converted chains and unity-gain pedal captures (README R7)
